name: opaquepixel-root-keep-alive
description: Root PM2 keep-alive service for OpaquePixel Render Backend

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "purple,cyan" "cd pixelvault-backend && .venv\Scripts\uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --reload" "cd pixelvault-frontend && npm run dev"
